## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Yí jiào jīng* in 1 fascicle is one of the most beloved short Buddhist texts in the East Asian tradition: the Buddha's final teaching-admonition (*jiào jiè* 教誡) delivered immediately before his *parinirvāṇa*, gathering together the essential disciplinary instructions for the *saṅgha*. The work was widely chanted in monastic establishments and was the subject of numerous commentaries, including Vasubandhu's *Yí jiào jīng lùn* 遺教經論 ([KR6g0044](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0044), T1529).
